checks.property: public native backing is tied to actual initial commitments
checks.result: Each GN3 row discloses its complete Note168, commitment and ciphertext/hash. The parser recomputes the note commitment and value, derives the complete initial CM/NF snapshot, requires exact sum-of-note backing at P2SH(state||selected tail), and checks three exact funding allocations and canonical ALL signature frames. No asserted initial root or private founder witness is accepted as backing.

checks.property: each owner authorizes its own admitted claim
checks.result: The worker first authenticates the externally selected unsigned case, own exact initial record, native quote and SDK roundtrip. Only then it reads its original seed and decrypts/rederives the invoice0 note. It checks the reserved funding index0xffffffff and signs only its matching input with SIGHASH_ALL. The exported result contains the ordinary signature and public context, never the seed.

checks.property: whole private parent is excluded before public ingress
checks.result: The signer omission gap identified during this review is fixed: the whole reserved private root must be in HostPolicy before public selectors are read. Source/selector/runtime metadata precedes public reads. Replay also enumerates retained page paths for metadata exclusion before SDK page reads.

checks.property: accepted graph is rederived from retained Full pages
checks.result: The SDK stage recomputes header hashes, fixed-frontier path coverage, transaction IDs and exact witness/body/context locators, reconstructs physical reserve edges, checks selected new-domain layout and immutable successor tail, and verifies current-point queries plus post-query delta/requery. It remains a validating-node observation rather than an independent consensus proof.

checks.property: financial/native replay is mandatory after SDK acquisition
checks.result: Replay validates full public GN3 records and selected descriptor, requires the fixed native emitter to reproduce the exact initial redeem/tail, executes Native Full and every input engine on every accepted case, reconstructs each exact native projection, verifies physical outpoint/state/reserve continuity and independently rebuilds NF/CM history. Final checkpoint and terminal status must agree with the SDK graph.

checks.property: canonical amounts cross the JS/Python boundary exactly
checks.result: RPC decimal strings are canonical, range-checked and converted once to Python integers before comparisons. Booleans, floats, signs, leading zeros and non-ASCII decimal alternatives are rejected. No JavaScript floating amount comparison is introduced.

checks.property: wallet history does not trust an asserted founding cache
checks.result: The owner independently rederives initial commitments/ciphertext hashes/note-value sum and roots, verifies successive financial proofs and tree transitions, and requires exact agreement with the externally selected current checkpoint. Accepted-chain authority remains the separate fixed chain reader.

resolved_findings.cause: The owner was under the reserved private root, but an unrelated caller exclusion list could leave that owner outside the public-read inode guard.
resolved_findings.fix: Require the whole selected private root in HostPolicy.new_directories before owner/public processing.
resolved_findings.verification: Source checked; author retained a synthetic before-any-public-read refusal control. The reviewer accessed no private contents.

remaining_gates: Execute complete local genuine mixed rounds, seed-only payment/change recovery and every direct exit under the final selected profile before funding.
Acquire actual TN10 accepted Full pages and replay them through this fixed SDK plus financial/native path; current source review is not a live run.
Original coordinator/prover removal and replacement retrieval need actual execution evidence; separately administered storage remains a distinct external dependency.
Miner/consolidation/source-funding tools added later have their own selection and are outside this frozen bootstrap/replay source review.
Single trusted host/selected software and validating RPC remain assumptions; finite receipt checks do not establish independent consensus or general privacy.
